_readme: Residential price table. Edit amounts here only; pages read from this file. Bands are inclusive. A record with approval other than 'approved' renders only in review builds and blocks a production build.

packages.name: Luxury Media
packages.for: The complete campaign for agents who want the listing and their own standard to stand out. Everything a strong launch needs, captured in one coordinated visit.

packages.name: Signature
packages.for: For properties and launches that deserve the full evening treatment: twilight stills and day-to-night film in both orientations.
packages.note: HD Photo Hub currently lists 2,985 / 3,155 / 3,325 / 3,495 and includes Agent on Camera.

packages.name: Social Media
packages.for: For listings launching mainly on Instagram, TikTok and Reels, where a vertical film carries the story.

packages.name: Social Media + Floor Plan
packages.for: The Social Media package with a schematic floor plan, so buyers understand the layout before the showing.
packages.note: Not currently offered as a product in HD Photo Hub.

packages.name: Listing Starter
packages.for: The fundamentals, done properly: a complete photo set, aerial context and a floor plan.

services.name: Photography
services.detail: Interior and exterior stills, with vertical social-ready frames where appropriate.

services.name: Photography + floor plan
services.detail: Full stills set plus a schematic floor plan.

services.name: Floor plan
services.detail: Schematic floor plan on its own.

services.name: Exterior-only ground + drone photography
services.detail: Exterior and aerial coverage without interiors.

services.name: Cinematic video, one orientation
services.detail: Choose a horizontal film or a vertical reel.
services.note: Matches HD Photo Hub (Cinematic Video / Cinematic Reel).

services.name: Cinematic video, both orientations
services.detail: A horizontal film and a vertical reel from the same shoot.

services.name: Day-to-night video, one orientation
services.detail: Daylight to evening transitions in a horizontal film or vertical reel.
services.note: HD Photo Hub offers only a fixed 'Add Day to Night' at $500.

services.name: Day-to-night video, both orientations
services.note: HD Photo Hub offers only a fixed 'Add Day to Night' at $500.

fixed.name: Add aerial photos to a shoot
fixed.note: Matches HD Photo Hub (Add Drone Photography). HD Photo Hub also lists an 'Add Drone' at $350.

fixed.name: Listing Engine
fixed.detail: Three to four short listing-cycle or location videos, captured alongside the listing media.
fixed.note: Matches HD Photo Hub add-on price; standalone listed at $1,200.

fixed.name: Agent Engine
fixed.detail: Three to four agent-focused vertical videos using the property as a premium backdrop.
fixed.note: Matches HD Photo Hub add-on price; standalone listed at $1,200.

fixed.name: Full Engine Bundle
fixed.detail: Listing Engine and Agent Engine together.
fixed.note: HD Photo Hub lists $1,900 as an add-on and $2,200 standalone.

startingOnly.name: Twilight photography
startingOnly.detail: Uses its own size rule (up to 5,000 sq ft, then 5,001–8,500 sq ft). Confirmed in the booking portal.
startingOnly.note: Documents list $500 / $575. HD Photo Hub shows five twilight tiers ($500–$725). Model by size only after confirming current bands.
